lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Pipelinq\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.
The frontend or a template builds 11 URLs below /apps/pipelinq/ that no route of the app matches. The request fails at run time.

vimeo/psalm, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

28 timed jobs do not say whether they are time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 166 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 719 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
6 public methods of controllers are reached by no route.
